QuestInfo.name: [Lunar New Year 2018] Nyen's Revenge
QuestInfo.0: Nyen has his eyes on Maple World for the Lunar New Year. Cassandra says he's planning to clone monsters from Maple World and other realms to wreak havoc on the festivities. Free the captured monsters he's cloning and put an end to Nyen's foul plot.
